messages.content: 你能估計2020年印度孟加拉虎的人口數量嗎？並將其與同年肯亞非洲象的估計人口數量進行比較，然後估計這兩種物種在各自國家的當前年份的人口數量嗎？

function.name: estimate_population
function.description: Estimate the population of a particular species in a given country. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

So we need to call the function estimate_population twice: once for Bengal tiger in India for year 2020, once for African elephant in Kenya for year 2020. Then we need to estimate the current year (which is 2026) populations for each species in their respective countries. So we need to call estimate_population again for Bengal tiger in India for year 2026, and for African elephant in Kenya for year 2026.
